service.name: Live music for Sunday brunch
service.serviceType: A jazz duo, solo guitarist or pianist for brunch at restaurants, hotels and clubs, and for private brunches
service.description: Upright bass and guitar, a solo guitarist, a Spanish guitarist or a pianist playing the standards under a Sunday brunch at 65 to 72 dBA, for a restaurant's, hotel's or club's standing Sunday and for private brunches, the morning after a wedding, a bridal brunch, a shower or a birthday, across Denver, the Front Range and the Colorado mountain corridor.

faqs.q: Can a restaurant or hotel book live music for brunch every Sunday?
faqs.a: Yes. A standing Sunday, weekly or monthly, runs on one contract with one personal contact for the run, with the same musicians every time. Tell us the seating times and the space and we'll come back with a recommendation and a price for the run. Signet Artists books brunch musicians across Denver.

About the level of the conversation at the tables, so a table of eight talks across it and the server can take an order without leaning in. Sets run 45 to 60 minutes with music through the breaks, so the dining space never goes quiet.

faqs.q: What does a dining space need?
faqs.a: A corner of about 8 by 6 feet for a duo or 6 by 4 for a solo, and one outlet. Setup takes 45 minutes to an hour before doors, so it's finished before the first seating, and packing up takes 30 to 45 minutes after the last. On a patio, a covered, level and dry spot with power or a battery-powered system, and a call time for moving inside. A certificate of insurance and a W-9 come with the quote.
